manual_evidence.colour: Reviewed figures/SMOKE_00a820ef-d655700e_120kbps_150f_colour_QA.png (daytime, 3 paired reference/decoded frames) and figures/SMOKE_00b04b12-a7d7eb85_120kbps_150f_colour_QA.png (nighttime, 3 paired frames): no evident systematic hue reversal, channel swap or gross color-range mismatch; reconstruction blur/quality loss is visible. All 7 validation source videos include nonempty ffprobe color metadata; no fallback was used; both reference and decoded detector paths use matched BT.709 limited color conversion. Visual sampling does not certify each frame or all 100 Test videos.
manual_evidence.encoder: All 35 logs/CALIBRATION_*_encode.log and run_records/CALIBRATION_*.json: vvencapp v1.14.0 reports VBR single-pass, QPA Enabled, intra period 32, refresh CRA, threads 4; each executed CLI contains --mtprofile -1 --additional GOPSize=32:LookAhead=1. Pinned VVenC source commit 9428ea8636ae7f443ecde89999d16b2dfc421524: source/Lib/apputils/VVEncAppCfg.h documents that additional options separated by colon are parsed after other options, and defines GOPSize and LookAhead parameters; source/Lib/vvenc/vvencCfg.cpp requires look-ahead for one-pass RC. The simple vvencapp runtime log does not expose a direct post-initialization dump of GOPSize/LookAhead. Effective values assessed by source parsing + unmodified successfully completed CLI, not API inspection.
